title: Why Your Ears Pop On A Plane ✈️

shots.vo: Your ears pop on a plane because of a tiny tube most people have never heard of.
shots.prompt: a passenger on an airplane holding their ear with a pained face, window light, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name

shots.vo: Behind your eardrum is a small pocket of air.
shots.prompt: a glowing 3D illustration of the inside of a human ear, eardrum and middle ear, dark background, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name

shots.vo: On the ground, the air pressure inside it matches the air outside.
shots.prompt: a calm passenger in an airplane seat before takeoff, soft cabin light, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name

shots.vo: But as the plane climbs, the cabin pressure drops. The air behind your eardrum pushes outward.
shots.prompt: an airliner climbing steeply through clouds, dramatic sky, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name

shots.vo: Your eardrum bulges, and everything sounds muffled.
shots.prompt: an extreme close-up of a human ear with a sense of pressure, moody lighting, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name

shots.vo: That little tube, connecting your ear to the back of your throat, has to open and let the air through.
shots.prompt: a medical illustration of the tube linking the middle ear to the throat, glowing, dark background, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name

shots.vo: Swallowing, yawning or chewing pulls it open. Pop. The pressure evens out.
shots.prompt: a passenger chewing gum and smiling on a plane, window with clouds, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name

shots.vo: That's why babies cry on landing, and why sucking on something helps them.
